title: MCP Hub
description: Expose this JupyterLite tab to an MCP hub so chat clients (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, …) can create and run notebook cells here. Pair once from the MCP Hub panel.

hubUrl.title: Hub URL
hubUrl.description: Base URL of the Cloudflare Worker hub.

pairId.title: Pair ID
pairId.description: Set by the Pair button; identifies this tab's Durable Object.

pairToken.title: Pair token
pairToken.description: Set by the Pair button; authenticates this tab as the runner for the pair.

maxImageBytes.title: Maximum image size
maxImageBytes.description: PNG output above this size is downscaled before being sent to the chat client.
